notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 2 power.
description:
Activate Sash and Waistcoat by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters, Trostani and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life
Repeat.
